scientific_integrity: The classical planar absolute constant and Daugavet duality are cited prior results. The new work proves fixed-codimension nonattainment via explicit finite-dimensional dual certificates and incompatible norming faces. The same-model review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Real C[0,1] only, and the three-interval family with 0<t<=1; complex and higher codimension cases are not established.
title: A sharp nonattaining codimension-two projection interval in real continuous-function space
